name: scheduling
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when scheduling moves to a different clock source (e.g. a native plugin cron API) or when the tick interval/route become config-driven and this slice's hardcoding is removed.
spec_no_change_reason: Durable heartbeat + SessionStart auto-resume (#31): adds heartbeat.py (durable loop-intent + cross-session arm-once auto-resume decision), wires start.py/stop.py to record/clear the intent, ships a SessionStart resume hook, and registers it in hooks.json — fulfilling the already-documented DESIGN §3.3.2/§3.3.4 heartbeat-durability intent; CHANGELOG bumped to contract 0.8.0.
